name: Pallery (formerly Loxo)
what: Buyer-enablement platform for B2B SaaS sales: a customizable self-serve hub where prospects explore, evaluate and onboard without booking a sales call.
homonym_note: Renamed from Loxo (loxoapp.com; still linked from pallery.com and its G2 listing 'loxo-prospect-engagement-platform'). Not Loxo the recruitment software (Austin, founded 2012), LOXO (Bern) or Loxo Oncology.

membership.basis: Listed on the live visionaries.vc portfolio (companies-2026); on the archived visionaries.vc/portfolio page as 'Loxo' in the 2024-04-24 capture and as 'Pallery' from the 2024-11-06 capture (same description). No press or company source names the Visionaries round.

graduation_surfaces: googlenews: "Pallery" and "Pallery" raises -> nothing (one unrelated Indian film hit)

WebSearch (2 calls): 'Pallery buyer enablement startup funding LocalGlobe Visionaries pre-seed' and 'Loxo loxoapp buyer onboarding startup raises seed LocalGlobe Phoenix Court 2021' -> only vendor profiles (CB Insights, Crunchbase, Tracxn, PitchBook, Clay); no press release of any round
notes: No announced round found under either name, so entry and funding_rounds are empty (searched). Vendor profiles only, not usable as citations: CB Insights (URL slug 'loxo-3') says Phoenix Court (LocalGlobe) and Visionaries Club invested in an early-stage deal dated 27-Oct-2021; Crunchbase, per a WebSearch summary, dates a seed round 27-Nov-2021 funded by Visionaries Club. If the judge accepts that dating, the entry is a 2021 seed (Seed Fund I era) and graduation stays open (no later round found). The site says 'Backed by LocalGlobe'. HQ London and founded 2021 from the company's LinkedIn page (Headquarters London, N1C 4AX; Founded 2021). The archived Visionaries page did not list Loxo in the 2023-06-01 capture, only from 2024-04-24, which sits oddly with a 2021 check; the 2023 capture may be incomplete.
